name: sedis
description: Query Sedis Bolagsanalys (listed-company financials) and Fastighetsbenchmark (real-estate comparables) in natural language — read-only.
long_description: A one-click Claude Desktop install of the Sedis PartnerAPI v2 MCP server. Ask questions about Sedis data — listed-company financials (Bolagsanalys) and real-estate comparables (Fastighetsbenchmark) — directly in Claude, in plain language. The server is a thin, read-only pass-through: it never writes or ingests data, and your API key is sent only as the X-Api-Key header and never logged. Get a key from your Sedis administrator; a customer-level (M2M) key needs no per-session two-factor step.

api_key.title: Sedis API key (PartnerAPI v2)
api_key.description: Your PartnerAPI v2 key. Sent only as the X-Api-Key header; never logged. Ask your Sedis administrator for one — pick a customer-level (M2M) key to skip the per-session two-factor step.
